techniques.ai: AI-painted: an image model redraws 3D or aerial imagery as one big illustration
techniques.data: Drawn from data: rendered in code from OpenStreetMap, city models or aerial photos
techniques.3d: 3D diorama: a real-time 3D scene, from low-poly models to voxels
techniques.classic: Classic: hand-made pixel art or early isometric maps from before the AI wave

atlases.name: tiny.london/world
atlases.about: The pixel-art world map from tiny.london. Add a city by issue or pull request.

atlases.name: Isometric Cities
atlases.about: A directory with a page per city, plus its own maps of Paris, Vienna, Rome, Singapore and Barcelona.

atlases.name: Isometric Map Finder
atlases.about: Every map on one world map, with who made it and what it was made from.

atlases.name: Isometric Cities Atlas
atlases.about: The Tiny Tirana team's list of maps on a spinning globe.

projects.name: Isometric NYC
projects.about: The map that started the wave: all of New York City in SimCity 2000-style pixel art, generated tile by tile by a fine-tuned image model. It also has a snow-day edition.

projects.name: Isometric New York
projects.about: A drawn New York you can zoom into, walk through at street level and fly a plane over.

projects.name: NYC Permit Pulse
projects.about: Live Department of Buildings permits plotted on top of Isometric NYC, so you can see where the city is changing.

projects.name: tiny.london
projects.about: All of Greater London as one pixel-art map of about 14 billion pixels. Search any place, station or postcode and share the view. Many of the “tiny” city maps that followed credit it.

projects.name: London, drawn
projects.about: 216 km² of central London redrawn one 700-metre square at a time, with 183 buildings you can open and the records behind them.

projects.name: Isometric London
projects.about: Central London, roughly Zones 1–2, drawn entirely in code from OpenStreetMap with no AI images. Rotate it in 90° steps and switch between day and night.

projects.name: London Field Atlas
projects.about: London's architecture in a metre-scale isometric 3D map, with building photographs and notes from visits.

projects.name: Tiny Rampage
projects.about: All of Zone 1 as a playable map that you get to wreck, built on top of tiny.london.

projects.name: ICanSee.MK
projects.about: Milton Keynes as several isometric maps, each painted by a different AI image model, so you can switch between their styles.

projects.name: Isometric Istanbul
projects.about: Both shores of the Bosphorus as an illustrated isometric map, redrawn from the city's own 3D model.

projects.name: İzometrik Türkiye
projects.about: A whole country rather than a city: a 3D relief map of 441 places, from Anıtkabir to Nemrut and Cappadocia, each turning into a miniature as you zoom in.

projects.name: Isometric Edirne
projects.about: Central Edirne at a fixed isometric angle over real aerial imagery, from the Selimiye Mosque to Karaağaç, with stories about the city. Nothing is redrawn by AI.

projects.name: Pixel Berlin
projects.about: All 891 km² of Berlin as one muted, hand-drawn-looking isometric map, searchable by address. An AI coding agent built the whole pipeline for about $100 of compute.

projects.name: Isometric Berlin
projects.about: The government quarter around the Reichstag as an explorable 3D scene from Berlin's official city model. Walk the streets or fly over the Spree.

projects.name: Wedding, gezeichnet
projects.about: Brüsseler Kiez and Sprengelkiez in Berlin-Wedding, illustrated by AI from Berlin's open 3D city model.

projects.name: Isometric Berlin
projects.about: Central Berlin inside the S-Bahn Ring, from Charlottenburg to Friedrichshain, built from the city's official 3D building model and aerial imagery. Rotate it a full 360°, set the time of day with night lighting, and share any view as a postcard.

projects.name: eBoy Pixoramas
projects.about: The pixel-art studio founded in Berlin in 1997, known for dense, hand-placed isometric “Pixorama” cityscapes such as New York. Sold as posters and prints.

projects.name: Isometric Warsaw
projects.about: The whole of Warsaw in pixel art, drawn live in the browser from open data: 197,000 buildings, trees, trams and trains, lit by the real sun.

projects.name: Tiny Warsaw
projects.about: An autumn, low-poly Warsaw from open data that follows the live time of day. Drive, take a bus or a balloon, or fly a plane with other visitors.

projects.name: Warsaw in voxels
projects.about: An interactive voxel model of Warsaw's city centre.

projects.name: HypeSeoul
projects.about: All of Seoul painted by AI as a living map that runs on Seoul time, with cars, boats and subway trains moved by real operating data.

projects.name: tinygyn
projects.about: Goiânia redrawn frame by frame as an isometric pixel-art map from the city's 3D model, with swaying trees and birds.

projects.name: tinyrj
projects.about: Rio de Janeiro redrawn as an isometric pixel-art map, frame by frame, from the city's 3D model.

projects.name: TinySP
projects.about: São Paulo in pixel art from Avenida Paulista to Ibirapuera, with day and night tiles and a search for any place.

projects.name: Tiny SP
projects.about: São Paulo redrawn as a little game map, from the old centre and Avenida Paulista to Pinheiros, the USP campus and Ibirapuera. It keeps growing.

projects.name: PUC-SP Consolação 3D map
projects.about: An interactive isometric 3D map of the PUC-SP Consolação campus, built with React Three Fiber.

projects.name: brasilia.isocity
projects.about: Niemeyer's modernist capital in isometric pixel art, painted on a single home GPU with Qwen-Image-Edit as one seamless canvas. The buttons nod to Athos Bulcão's tiles.

projects.name: JF em Pixels
projects.about: Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, as an isometric pixel-art map packed with local information.

projects.name: earthToPixels: João Pessoa
projects.about: João Pessoa in SimCity style: aerial tiles restyled by a model fine-tuned on hand-made pixel cities. The pipeline is built to render any coordinates.

projects.name: Tiny Orindiúva
projects.about: A small town in São Paulo state as a living isometric map: OpenStreetMap streets, 2,316 real building outlines, procedural pixel art and the local weather.

projects.name: Imperatriz em miniatura
projects.about: A “tiny city” model of Imperatriz, Maranhão: 136,824 buildings extruded to their estimated heights, with a day clock, trees in the wind and moving vehicles.

projects.name: Tiny Stockholm
projects.about: Stockholm, Solna and Sundbyberg as one seamless pixel-art map, redrawn with the tiny.london style model, with live trains, buses and boats.

projects.name: tiny detroit
projects.about: The whole City of Detroit as one pixel-art map. Zoom from the riverfront down to a single house on your block.

projects.name: tiny.blr
projects.about: Greater Bengaluru from Google's 3D map as one isometric map. Zoom down to single streets and find any place or Namma Metro station.

projects.name: How Bangalore moves
projects.about: An isometric simulation of the city's commute: add when people leave home, where they go and how long the ride takes, then watch the day play out.

projects.name: Isometric Bengaluru
projects.about: Isometric data visualizations of the city: land cover since 1973, Namma Metro, monsoon climate normals and census population.

projects.name: Isometric Mumbai
projects.about: All of Greater Mumbai, about 560 km² from Colaba to Dahisar, with simulated taxis, BEST buses, autos and local trains. Google's 3D mesh is flat here, so the open pipeline builds its own 3D city first.

projects.name: SimCABA
projects.about: Buenos Aires in SimCity style, stitched together from more than 12,000 generated images.

projects.name: pixis
projects.about: An arcade flight over an isometric pixel-art Neuquén, taking off from the Monumento a la Bandera.

projects.name: Isopolis
projects.about: San Francisco as one giant isometric pixel painting by a fine-tuned image model, dotted with hundreds of landmarks and startup offices. Visitors can suggest new places.

projects.name: isometric sf
projects.about: The entire Bay Area, more than 1,300 square miles, as one pixel-art map painted by a small image-to-image model. Search a town or address and send someone the view.

projects.name: SF Isometric (North Beach demo)
projects.about: The first test that led to isometric sf: North Beach and downtown as one continuous raster, generated tile by tile.

projects.name: SimLeón
projects.about: León, Guanajuato, as an isometric pixel-art map in the style of SimCity 2000, drawn from Google's 3D map.

projects.name: CDMX Isométrica
projects.about: Mexico City in pixel art, built from real OpenStreetMap data, with the Centro Histórico, Reforma, Xochimilco and more than 2,000 places of interest.

projects.name: tinyvancouver
projects.about: A sunny pixel-art Vancouver made from one real 3D source view, with place labels, evening light and a little flight mode.

projects.name: Isometric Vancouver
projects.about: Central Vancouver as one isometric illustration about 4.4 km across, from Stanley Park and Gastown south to King Edward Avenue.

projects.name: Isometric Cities: Vancouver
projects.about: A sample of Canada Place and Coal Harbour in SimCity 2000-style pixel art.

projects.name: Isometric Cities: Toronto
projects.about: Downtown Toronto, the waterfront and the Islands as a SimCity 2000-style deep-zoom map, following the Isometric NYC method.

projects.name: Isometric Toronto
projects.about: Downtown Toronto from Bathurst to the Don and Bloor to the harbour as an illustrated map, a homage to the city builders of the 1990s.

projects.name: Tiny Toronto
projects.about: Toronto from the lake northward as an illustrated, zoomable map, redrawn tile by tile by image models.

projects.name: Tiny Toronto
projects.about: A painted Toronto where every building is real: point at one to find out what it is.

projects.name: Isometric Cities: Montreal
projects.about: Griffintown and Old Montreal, the newest map in the same series as the Toronto one.

projects.name: Isometric Cities: Ottawa
projects.about: A sample around Parliament Hill in SimCity 2000-style pixel art.

projects.name: Isometric Cities: Victoria
projects.about: A sample of the Inner Harbour and the BC Legislature in SimCity 2000-style pixel art.

projects.name: tiny tashkent
projects.about: All of Tashkent as an illustrated isometric map covering every district, from Chilonzor and Yunusobod to Sergeli and Bektemir.

projects.name: iso-tash
projects.about: A living pixel-art Tashkent rendered in real time with WebGL 2 and three.js from OpenStreetMap, with a shader for pixel colours, dithering and outlines. Code only: you run it yourself.
Rotterdam in miniature, built from the city's 3D model, with real sunlight and lit windows after dark.

projects.name: Isometric Amsterdam
projects.about: Amsterdam's historic centre in pixel art, with all 68,543 buildings at their real heights.

projects.name: Tiny Utrecht
projects.about: Central Utrecht, 3 × 1.8 km from Lombok to Wilhelminapark, redrawn as pixel art by Gemini from Google's 3D tiles and checked against OpenStreetMap. The repository documents the whole pipeline.

projects.name: Abidjan en miniature
projects.about: Le Plateau, Abidjan's business district, drawn building by building from OpenStreetMap and aerial photos.

projects.name: Isometric Málaga
projects.about: The Mediterranean coast, the cathedral, the port and the La Malagueta bullring as an isometric pixel-art map.

projects.name: Tiny Barcelona
projects.about: Barcelona redrawn as a game map that visitors change together: demolish, build and see who else is online.

projects.name: Isometric Barcelona
projects.about: The Eixample grid, the Gothic Quarter, Barceloneta and Montjuïc from OpenStreetMap, with Gaudí's buildings at their real heights and cars, trams and boats.

projects.name: Tiny València
projects.about: València painted block by block as an isometric pixel-art map, from the Micalet to the beach.

projects.name: tiny lisbon
projects.about: Lisbon as one zoomable isometric pixel-art map.

projects.name: Tiny Belgrade
projects.about: Belgrade as one isometric pixel-art map, from Kalemegdan and Knez Mihailova to New Belgrade and Zemun. Drag, zoom and search.

projects.name: Tiny Prague
projects.about: The whole of Prague as a live isometric map from open data, where every building has its real roof, by day or night and in vector or pixel style.

projects.name: Tiny Prague
projects.about: All of Prague as a stylized isometric map redrawn from Google Earth captures, with metro and tram lines and a landmark search.

projects.name: Tiny Prague
projects.about: All of Prague as a real-time low-poly 3D city with live trams, buses and metro, planes, landmarks, sun-driven day and night, and a route planner.

projects.name: Izometrická 3D mapa ČR
projects.about: An early isometric 3D map of the whole Czech Republic rendered from OpenStreetMap. It reached Hacker News back in 2010 and is still online.

projects.name: tiny frankfurt
projects.about: Frankfurt am Main with trams, boats and people, starting with the skyline, the Altstadt and Sachsenhausen and growing square by square.

projects.name: Isometric Los Angeles
projects.about: Every street from the Valley to the harbor as one giant isometric image. Search for a place, or zoom in and wander.

projects.name: Isometric Atlanta
projects.about: Downtown Atlanta in RollerCoaster Tycoon style, following the Isometric NYC pipeline with a fine-tuned image-edit model. The live page is the renderer that captures the source tiles.

projects.name: Isometric Knoxville
projects.about: A pipeline for a gigapixel pixel-art Knoxville from aerial imagery, OpenStreetMap buildings and Tennessee LiDAR, stylized by a fine-tuned model. Code only.

projects.name: IsoPhilly
projects.about: A small isometric Philadelphia built from official city building data, 2025 aerial photos and the street-tree inventory, with neighbourhood overlays.

projects.name: Tahoe Trails
projects.about: A watercolor-style isometric model of the hiking and mountain-bike trails around Lake Tahoe, including trails approved to be built next.

projects.name: Walk North Campus
projects.about: A walkable isometric map of the University of Georgia's North and Central Campus, built from OpenStreetMap with Kenney's CC0 art. An unofficial fan project.

projects.name: Isometric Paris
projects.about: Central Paris at night, from the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe to Montmartre, Notre-Dame and Père Lachaise, with real streets and building heights.

projects.name: Isometric Vienna
projects.about: From St. Stephen's Cathedral and the Ringstraße to Schönbrunn, the Prater's Riesenrad and the Danube, with trams, cars and boats by day or night.

projects.name: Isometric Rome
projects.about: From St. Peter's and Castel Sant'Angelo across the Tiber to the Pantheon, Piazza Navona, the Forum and the Colosseum, by day or night.

projects.name: Isometric Singapore
projects.about: Marina Bay Sands, the Supertrees, the Singapore Flyer, Raffles Place, Chinatown and Orchard Road as an isometric pixel-art city, by day or night.

projects.name: Tiny Tirana
projects.about: Tirana painted block by block by a diffusion model trained on the city's 3D view, with 46 landmark cards, live planes over Rinas, buses on the real timetable and the Dajti cable car.

projects.name: tiny athens
projects.about: Athens in pixel art with live buses and trolleys, painted almost entirely on a MacBook Air by a small style model trained on Gemini drawings.

projects.name: Isometric Luxembourg
projects.about: Luxembourg City as an inked illustration that follows the real clock, with painted seasons, Christmas markets, trams and trains on today's timetable and 47 landmark cards. The old town is finished; the rest is being painted.

projects.name: Leuven Social
projects.about: Leuven's historic centre as a tiny pixel-art 3D city from open data. Walk or cycle around, or ride off on a bike from a rack.

projects.name: Mini Lagos
projects.about: A cute, stylized miniature 3D map of Lagos with a tilted camera, extruded buildings and floating labels.

projects.name: Saigon Rush Hour
projects.about: An isometric 3D traffic simulator of District 1 at rush hour, on the real street map.

projects.name: isometric.tokyo
projects.about: An illustrated isometric Tokyo in development from open Project PLATEAU data. So far: a 5120 × 5120 pixel pilot around Shinjuku, with AI-assisted art studies.

projects.name: Tiny Madrid
projects.about: Madrid inside the M-30 as illustrations laid over the city's own 3D model, with a hundred monuments to visit, a Windows 98-style interface and modes to drive, fly or race.

projects.name: TinyLyon
projects.about: Lyon's nine arrondissements and Villeurbanne painted as one map between the Rhône and the Saône, with trams T1 to T6, landmarks, postcards to share and modes to drive, fly or race.

projects.name: Tiny Rome
projects.about: Rome redrawn by an image model as an inked, hand-coloured map you can zoom into roof by roof, with its famous places and a story mode that plays 2,700 years of history where it happened.

projects.name: Tiny Geneva
projects.about: Geneva built live in the browser from Swiss open data (terrain, roofs and the year each building went up), with real departures on the public transport and the planes overhead.

projects.name: Tiny Brussels
projects.about: The EU quarter of Brussels as a living miniature built from the region's open 3D data: real buildings, the weather and time of day as they are now, trams, the Sunday market and favourite cafés.

projects.name: Isometric Kinderdijk
projects.about: The nineteen UNESCO windmills of Kinderdijk, rendered from Dutch 3D data and redrawn as pixel art with Grok Imagine, with a story and a photo for every mill and a game where you run one.

projects.name: Kraków w pikselach
projects.about: Kraków as a 3D pixel-art map with a timeline of 16 eras, from the wooden fort on Wawel in 965 to today, trams that run to the real timetable and windows that light up at night.

projects.name: Isometric Kraków
projects.about: The whole of Kraków drawn live in the browser from open data: Wawel, the Main Market Square, Kazimierz and the Vistula, by day, at dusk, at night or under snow, with trams running.

projects.name: Isometric Bielsko-Biała
projects.about: The whole city as pixel art rendered live from open data and lidar, with the real sun, four seasons, buses at their live positions, trains on the timetable and hand-made landmarks.

projects.name: Tiny Casablanca
projects.about: Downtown Casablanca around Place des Nations Unies, the clock tower, the Grand Théâtre and the old medina, redrawn as 16-bit pixel art with Google's Gemini image model.

projects.name: Isometric Istanbul — Day & Night
projects.about: Galata, Karaköy and the north of Eminönü drawn building by building from OpenStreetMap, with the Galata Tower at the centre and a switch between day and night.

projects.name: Isometric Beijing
projects.about: A pixel-art 3D Beijing built from OpenStreetMap buildings, with buttons that take you to the Forbidden City, the Guomao CBD and the Olympic park.

projects.name: TinySeoul
projects.about: Seoul as a tilt-shift miniature on the national VWorld 3D model, with night lights and a line-drawing mode; cut out any spot and export it as a PNG or a vector SVG.

projects.name: Pixel Hyderabad
projects.about: The old and new city of Hyderabad rendered as isometric pixel art from OpenStreetMap and elevation data. Building heights are estimated, since most are not mapped.

projects.name: Pixel Singapore
projects.about: Central Singapore as an AI-drawn pixel map, alive with traffic, birds and swaying trees, with a switch between 2016 and 2026. A write-up explains how it was made.

projects.name: Pixel Sydney
projects.about: Inner Sydney from the CBD towers to Surry Hills, Newtown and Bondi, every building drawn from open data and every business on the map, with layers for trains, ferries and school catchments.

projects.name: Pixel Melbourne
projects.about: Inner Melbourne from the Hoddle Grid to Fitzroy, St Kilda and Footscray, every building extruded from open data, with trams, heritage buildings, laneways and the businesses inside.

projects.name: Pixel Brisbane
projects.about: All of Brisbane as a pixel city, every building drawn from open data with 11,000 businesses inside, plus layers for trains, CityCats, river flood zones and schools.

projects.name: Pixel Perth
projects.about: Inner Perth from St Georges Terrace and Elizabeth Quay to Northbridge, Leederville and Subiaco, every building at its real height and every business in the building it occupies.

projects.name: Pixel Adelaide
projects.about: Adelaide's square mile inside its ring of Park Lands and the inner suburbs around it, every building at its true height and every shop on Rundle Street in the building it occupies.

projects.name: Pixel Gold Coast
projects.about: The Gold Coast from the Broadwater past the Surfers Paradise towers to Coolangatta, every building drawn from open data, with the businesses inside and a flood map for each one.

projects.name: Pixel Sunshine Coast
projects.about: The Sunshine Coast from Caloundra to Tewantin and up into the hinterland, every building drawn from open data, with the businesses inside, the railway stations and flood mapping.

projects.name: Isometric Seattle
projects.about: Seattle from Golden Gardens and Green Lake to Harbor Island and Alki as one giant illustration, traced tile by tile by an image model from Google's 3D city; the water is painted, not traced.

projects.name: Isometric San Francisco
projects.about: Every building in San Francisco drawn with AI from public data, in an illustrated version and an 8-bit pixel version, with a guided tour and lists of places and companies.

projects.name: Isometric NYC, drawn in code
projects.about: All five boroughs as pixel art built entirely in code from NYC Open Data, the city's 2017 lidar survey and OpenStreetMap, with golden-hour, morning and night light and a dithered look.

projects.name: Iso Cincy
projects.about: Greater Cincinnati in 3D, following the real time of day, the weather and the level of the Ohio River, with live traffic, a mural tour, a slider back to 1788 and a mode that floods the valley.

projects.name: Isometric State College
projects.about: State College and Penn State as a 90s city-builder picture: Google's 3D model of the town, repainted by an open Qwen model trained on GPT Image examples, in seven seasons and times of day.

projects.name: Isometric Albuquerque
projects.about: The Albuquerque metro from the Sandia crest to the West Mesa volcanoes, rendered from OpenStreetMap and elevation data, with an overlay of parishes, Mass times, trails and public land.
